blocks.text: UNVEILING IMMORALITY- Many times God will allow Hollywood film producers to reveal often what will occur in the future. Most of theses films are making parts one and two allowing a triple witness. - Dan 11:24 “Yea, and he shall forecast his devices against the strong holds, even for a time.” For instance, around 1977 a picture was release called Halloween, and for the first time this sort revealed terrible murders, violence, sex and terror to come. Young people saw this and it certainly did describe the future.

BATTLE OF FORCES - Next, Star Wars.- A picture depicting good end evil in the universe. As described in Rev. 12: 7 where Michael $s angels fought against Satan’s angels. And there was a war in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon; and the dragon fought and his angels. ‘Verse 8, And prevailed not; neither was their place found any more in heaven.” - This was one of the largest grossing pictures of all time.

ANTICHRIST PREVIEW - Next -Superman film was released. It described the strength, ability and power of a super man in science, inventions, etc. And also creating hero worship. And sure enough a superman, antichrist will appear. 1 Thess. 2:4 “Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshiped; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God.’ - And the U.S.A. has followed this pattern of a super power. So we see it fulfilling, matching the Scripts and predictions.

SUBTILE POWERS - Once again another film was released called Batman and this was symbolic. I preached, “as you would see bats come our of a cave by the thousands, Satan will release millions of demons out of the pit.” And we have seen that come to pass indeed! - All types are manifesting across the world and more is yet to come. Bat pattern is a type of the demon power. Reuv.9: 2,3 - And he opened the bottomless pit; and there arose a smoke out of the pit, and the smoke of the great furnace; and the sun and air were darkened by reason of the smoke of the pit. And there came out of the smoke locusts upon the earth, and unto them was given power, as the scorpions of the earth have power.”

INTERVENTION - Note this film, The Terminator, reveals old things terminating and new things beginning and the self-will of people against God. It absolutely occurred. It also showed high technology and science, etc. So again we see God allowed man to reveal the future.
In the second series the Terminator would try to stop Armageddon. But in real life it won’t be stopped. In fact some films are showing total annihilation of the world. But that’s not
true because Jesus will intervene. Mait.24: 22, ‘And except those days should be shortened, there should be no flesh saved: but for the elect's sake those days shall be shortened.”

EARTH’S SNARE - The Spiderman film reveals he cast his web over the entire world like a net. The U.S.A. and world is caught ina web, a spider’s web. Luke 21:35, “For as a snare shall it come on all them that dwell on the face of the whole earth.” The whole world will be snared. The film shows exactly what is happening. Commercial and religious Babylon will be Rev. 17:5 and Chapter 18 will be the snare. (This film had the biggest opening weekend so far among other films released at the time.) - Stay out of the web, snare, because even now this world and nation is trapped. Only the Elect will get out and will find the door. It is closing!

A DRAMATIC PREVIEW - The celestial not only confirms the Bible now, but the Great Pyramid and scripts, that awesome events of all time will begin to take place from about 2007- 2012. We will explain the great eclipses and constellations later. Notwithstanding, even before these dates some of the greatest events we have ever seen will take place. And this also includes the last great outpouring from the Lord that we’re even in now. He’s going to wrap us up in glittering light indeed! It’s appointed and shall not fail. The best word that I can give you is to be ready at all times. Pray ye escape all these things, saith the Lord, that certainly will be coming upon a world of all types of madness and a world of corruption and false religion. Amen. Praise the Lord Jesus for his insight!

And for your encouragement read this Scripture, Psa/ms 34.19, “Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but the Lord delivereth him out of them all.” Ready atall times.
